newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: HERMIS BANK 7 MO PROFIT 16.3 MLN. [CORRECTED 10:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: HERMIS BANK 7 MO PROFIT 16.3 MLN. [CORRECTED 10:25 GMT]

text.p: (all amounts in million litas unless otherwise stated)
- Hermis Bank, the second largest commercial bank in the country, provided no comparative figures for the same period last year in the statement.
- Hermis Bank posted 14.3 million (corrects from 134.3 million) litas net profit for the first half of 1997 after it made a net profit for all of last year of 27.4 million litas.
- The bank also reported assets of 741.6 million litas, loan portfolio of 393.7 million litas, deposits of 542.4 million litas and individual deposits of 110 million litas as of end of June 1997.
- The share capital of the bank is 90 million litas.
- Hermis Bank is one of the two banking shares listed on the Vilnius bourse's elite official list.
